name: Input
purpose: Provide headless native single-line text entry that participates in Field relationships and controlled or uncontrolled value handling.
useWhen: The user enters one line of text, email, search, URL, telephone, or another supported native input value.
composition: Place Input.Root inside one Field.Root with Field.Label; add a stable name when it participates in submission.

rules.statement: Give every Input an accessible name, normally through Field.Label.
Choose the narrowest correct native type and autocomplete value.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using placeholder text as the only label.
commonMistakes.correction: Add a persistent Field.Label and keep placeholder text optional.

validation: Inspect name, type, autocomplete, label, and description relationships.
Test keyboard entry and browser autofill where relevant.
